fullContentHtml:
Uttarakhand TET UTET Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttarakhand Board of School Education (UBSE) has released Admit Card for the recruitment of Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test UTET Exam 2026 on the official website. Applications for the Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from July 14, 2026, to August 03, 2026. The written examination is going to conducted on 29 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Uttarakhand TET UTET Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date : 03 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 August 2026
  • Modify Application Form : 08-11 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • For Single Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 300/-
  • For Both Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 500/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Uttarakhand TET UTET Admit Card 2026?

Uttarakhand TET UTET Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 03 August 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://ukutet.com/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
